name: scanner-unexpected-exit
description: An external scanner exited with an unrecognized code (5) and an empty stdout, but its result was still recorded (the orchestrator classifies exit codes, not the engine). Both sides must treat a recorded ERROR scanner result the same way the timeout fixture does: never a pass. This pins that the engine trusts the *recorded* scanner status, not an exit-code guess, so an unexpected exit is an ERROR and a hard FAIL.

error.message: npm audit exited with unexpected code 5

notes: unrecognized exit code; treat as an error, not a pass
